text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shortly before the start of summer
camp...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After reading the same article over and
over,
Yamanin Zephyr finally mumbles
something in a
trembling voice.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No... It can't be...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Does this mean that she won't recover in
time?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...That Teio won't make it to the Kikuka
Sho?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A broken bone that'll take six months to
heal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The undefeated Tokai Teio conquered the
Japanese Derby and stood just one
step away
from the Triple Crown when
disaster struck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her path to the Kikuka Sho has
crumbled. That's how it's being reported
every day, and a month
after the
announcement, all hope has faded away.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(A lonely wind... blowing in silence,
through
darkness.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(It's as if countless people's tears are
spreading
throughout the atmosphere,
weighing it down
with sorrow.)
Wait, Zephyr? Why the long face?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh?! T-Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Y-your leg, your body! How—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that? Don't worry about any of that
stuff,
Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, the cast's come off, and
rehab's
going super smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just watch and wait—I'll be at the
Kikuka Sho, no
matter what! I mean, was
it ever in doubt?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
B-but... wasn't a full recovery supposed
to take
six months?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's as though you expect to raise a
summer squall
in autumn—it's just not
possible.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if it's not possible...
I make
the
impossible possible.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There's a high wall and a steep road
ahead, but I
knew from the start I'd have
all that waiting for
me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I knew that, and I'm aiming for the top
anyway! I'm going to be the undefeated
Triple Crown
Monarch who surpasses the
Emperor!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can't afford to let something
like this
stop me in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep racing towards my
dream at full
speed!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, you're entering the Sprinters
Stakes
next, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A big G1! Make sure you show everyone
your
cool side, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're giving it your all just like I
am, so
believe
it or not, I'm really rooting for
you!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(How curious. Even with all these heavy
clouds in
the sky above...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Teio carries the fragrance of a sunlit
breeze.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (That... shouldn't be, and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr starts summer camp
with such a radiant expression that I can
hardly believe she
was veiled in gloom
just before.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I spoke to Teio.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...And I felt utterly ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ashamed at how overwhelmed I felt
in the
face of Ruby's aura, and how
intimidated I was by
Helios's potential.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wall is high and the road ahead is
steep. I might have been a bit slow to
realize, but really,
that's something I've
known all along.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Would something so
enchanting—something
you've yearned
for—ever simply fall into your
lap?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But even if it did, it matters not.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The tempest that rages in my heart
cannot be
calmed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Please, build me up—until I'm
strong
and sharp enough to overpower
even the
windblasts of autumn.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep moving forwards—to race
towards
my dream at a blistering pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins my summer with Yamanin
Zephyr.
choice_data_list: Got it...! Leave it to me!
Got it...! Leave it to me!
